title: Cardinality of $k$-tuples over the Boolean hypercube
statement: Fix natural numbers $n$ and $k$, and let $\{0,1\}^n$ denote the Boolean hypercube of dimension $n$. The set of $k$-tuples of points of $\{0,1\}^n$, that is $\left(\{0,1\}^n\right)^k$, has exactly $2^{nk}$ elements.
hypotheses_covered: natural number k (number of tuple coordinates)
replaced:
The number of $k$-tuples of vectors in $\{0,1\}^n$ is
$|(\{0,1\}^n)^k| = 2^{nk}$.
